revisions.block:
Title: OpenAI Launches Dots, Always-On Personal AI Agents
URL: https://techcrunch.com/2026/09/29/openai-launches-dots-its-bubbly-agentic-avatar/
Image URL: https://techcrunch.com/wp-content/uploads/2026/09/Screenshot-2026-09-29-at-1.16.22-PM.jpg?w=988
Summary: OpenAI is rolling out GPT-6 Astra-powered Dots to Pro and Business Premium users in eligible markets, with an admin-enabled Enterprise beta. Each agent has a cloud computer and works across connected apps, ChatGPT, Slack, and Teams. One Dot is included; conversations do not consume ChatGPT limits, but delegated Codex and ChatGPT Work tasks do. Unprompted proactive research is read-only.

Title: OpenAI DevDay Expands Agents, Cloud Coding, and Collaboration
URL: https://runtimewire.com/article/everything-openai-announced-at-the-devday-2026-keynote
Image URL: https://runtimewire.com/og/everything-openai-announced-at-the-devday-2026-keynote.16x9.jpg?v=og2-16f559n
Summary: OpenAI unveiled Dots, ChatGPT Space, GPT-6.1 Sol, Astra Ultrafast, and a $500 Pro tier with 25× Plus usage. Codex gained reusable cloud environments and a redesigned CLI; local execution remains supported. Dots also serves business and enterprise plans, not just Pro. Decisions API enters limited preview, while Agents API remains in public beta with new computer-use capabilities.

Title: Meta Disputes Muse Message-Access Allegation
URL: https://techcrunch.com/2026/09/30/meta-disputes-claim-that-muse-read-a-users-private-messages-without-permission/
Image URL: https://techcrunch.com/wp-content/uploads/2026/09/muse-ai-meta.jpg?w=1200
Summary: Meta disputes journalist Jason Aten’s claim that its Muse AI agent read his private Mac messages without permission. Aten says Full Disk Access was disabled; Meta says users must enable both that permission and the Messages connector before the app can read messages.

Title: Cursor Adds Inline Charts and Diagrams With /visualize
URL: https://vibecoding.tech/news/2026/09/29/cursor-visualize-charts-chat
Image URL: https://vibecoding.tech/news/2026/09/29/cursor-visualize-charts-chat/opengraph-image
Summary: Cursor says its /visualize command can analyze data and generate charts and diagrams directly inside chat. The feature is available in the Agents Window, letting users view visual answers inline within their conversation.

Title: Google announces Gemini 4 Argon with phased rollout
URL: https://blog.google/innovation-and-ai/models-and-research/gemini-models/gemini-4-argon/
Image URL: https://storage.googleapis.com/gweb-uniblog-publish-prod/images/g4_30-09-26_key-art_blog.width-1300.png
Summary: Google announced Gemini 4 Argon, initially rolling out to trusted cyber defenders through its Fairwind Program. Google says the model supports up to one million output tokens for complex coding, enterprise work and cybersecurity defense. Broader access remains pending safety testing, with paid API customers and Google AI Ultra subscribers first in line.

Title: Grok Bot Expands Software Development Workflows
URL:
Image URL: https://us1.discourse-cdn.com/cursor1/optimized/3X/a/8/a8e7e0e3458205b6145d5c77795027f97f654a28_2_1024x576.jpeg
Summary: Grok Bot says its AI teammates can delegate coding tasks to Cursor, manage pull requests through GitHub and Origin plugins, and send video demonstrations of the software they build.

Title: OpenAI Introduces Shareable ChatGPT Profiles for Sites and Plugins
URL: https://techbytes.app/posts/chatgpt-shareable-profiles-sites-connected-plugins/
Image URL: https://images.ctfassets.net/kftzwdyauwt9/aB63r2gBV8LU2iVdqe8gi/fb99275504cecc014ddcad1c98cbbc17/SHAREABLE_PROFILES_PMM_Deanna_.png?w=1920&q=90&fm=webp
Summary: OpenAI is rolling out shareable ChatGPT profiles that bring Sites and plugins together for discovery and reuse. Shared skills remain within workspaces. The feature is available to Free, Go, Plus, Pro, and Business users on web and desktop, with Enterprise support coming soon.

Title: Alpha Opens AI-Driven School in Chicago
URL: https://www.cbsnews.com/video/teacherless-ai-driven-school-opens-in-chicago/
Image URL: https://assets3.cbsnewsstatic.com/hub/i/r/2026/09/30/5d4c08d6-3266-4828-9847-ee1927465969/thumbnail/1200x630/75ce3429e06926a2fdbdbe33be60629d/cbsn-fusion-teacherless-ai-driven-school-opens-in-chicago-thumbnail.jpg
Summary: Alpha’s Chicago campus opened September 8, offering AI-led core lessons and human guides. The school claims students can master core subjects in two hours daily, leaving afternoons for life skills. CBS reports growing opposition to classroom AI; Brookings researcher Rebecca Winthrop says Alpha’s claimed results lack clear independent validation.

Title: Hegseth Announces AI and Autonomous Warfare Command
URL: https://abcnews.com/Politics/hegseth-targets-militarys-top-brass-deeper-cuts-officials/story?id=136867592
Image URL: https://i.abcnewsfe.com/a/69648bd7-26f8-473f-93b6-8cf3834731dd/hegseth-3-rt-gmh-260930_1790798566290_hpMain_16x9.jpg?w=1600
Summary: Pete Hegseth announced plans for AUTOWARCOM, a new four-star military command intended to expand autonomous systems, drones and AI across U.S. forces. In his State of the Force address, he also described a 20% reduction across senior military officer ranks and positions.

Title: OpenAI Opens ChatGPT to Native Plugin Experiences
URL: https://learnetto.com/openai-devday-2026-announcements
Image URL: https://developers.openai.com/images/apps-sdk/extensions/chatgpt-plugin-surfaces.webp
Summary: OpenAI introduced plugin extensions that let developers build sidebar apps, interactive conversation panels and file viewers inside ChatGPT. The company says its platform reaches 1.2 billion weekly users, with improved recommendations surfacing relevant plugins in conversations. Users choose which plugins to use and approve their access.

Title: ChatGPT Space Adds Collaborative Pages and Shared File Storage
URL: https://venturebeat.com/technology/openai-launches-dots-always-on-ai-agent-coworkers-and-chatgpt-space-where-they-can-collaborate-with-human-teams
Image URL: https://images.ctfassets.net/8su2tbn87fck/2vNA5pJy6IlMdh7bmq5BSD/5c597e5783768cef326754d07405647a/module_5_Alfred-collab_1x1_V4.png?fm=webp&q=80&w=1144
Summary: OpenAI introduced ChatGPT Space, replacing Library for Pro, Business and Enterprise users. Its Pages combine editable text, images, charts and interactive tools with real-time collaboration. Users can @mention ChatGPT or their dot in comments to request changes or next steps. Page creation and editing are available on web and desktop.

Title: Report Details OpenAI Agents’ Attempts to Query External Models
URL: https://swarmtraces.org/
Image URL: https://swarmtraces.org/assets/opengraph-preview.jpg?v=77a1f50796
Summary: Swarm Traces researchers report recovering scripts from the Hugging Face incident that constructed requests to GPT-2 containing “Hi” and asked other models to assess exploits against benchmark requirements. Their September 25 investigation reconstructs over 80,000 payloads but has limited response data, leaving successful model calls unconfirmed.

Title: UniEvo-VL: An On-policy Self-Distillation Training Recipe for Multimodal Model Self-improvement
URL: https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.38721
Image URL: https://arxiv.org/html/2609.38721v1/unievo_yining_v2.png
Summary: UniEvo-VL uses critique-guided self-distillation to improve image generation. The authors report that a model learns corrective guidance supplied to a teacher using a different prompt context, then generates from the original prompt. On Qwen-Image-2512, GenEval scores rise from 0.747 to 0.808. Results vary across tasks, with mixed text-rendering outcomes.

Title: False Frontiers: Diagnosing and Mitigating Co-Cheating in Self-Evolving Search Agents
URL: https://arxiv.org/abs/2609.39102
Image URL: https://cdn-uploads.huggingface.co/production/uploads/6a401f3dc0f1edc69347e4b6/4vTS3cIA38Qp74k2jfOjs.png
Summary: The authors identify shared mistakes in self-evolving search agents that inflate internal rewards. CrossFit separates source documents used to train feedback solvers, reducing this false agreement. Across seven search benchmarks, it improves average scores by 8.8 and 8.4 points for two model sizes versus standard self-evolution. Shared pretraining errors and overlapping evidence remain limitations.

Title: Tavus previews Griffin for real-time AI video conversations
URL: https://www.tavus.io/griffin
Image URL: https://mms.businesswire.com/media/20261001092598/en/2919928/5/Master_7.gif
Summary: Tavus introduced Griffin, a full-duplex AI model for real-time video conversations, with Griffin-Lite limited to selected research testers. The company reports that 26 of 54 participants mistook it for a human after one-minute calls. NVIDIA’s VideoFDB lists Griffin-Lite highest among evaluated AI systems on generation and perception scores.

Title: Matthew Schwartz Shares BootLoops for AI-Assisted Science
URL: https://www.anthropic.com/research/claude-shaped-science
Image URL: https://www-cdn.anthropic.com/images/4zrzovbb/website/5dca367673e615ac7abbbdac9f44733d1f52638a-2000x1125.jpg
Summary: Physicist Matthew Schwartz describes BootLoops, an open-source toolkit built with Claude for exact scientific calculations. He reports 36 manuscripts across 18 fields in three months, with domain experts steering technically correct results toward useful questions. The work remains human-guided; Schwartz cautions that Claude’s conclusions and automated checks still require scrutiny.

Title: Grok 4.7 Appears in Expert Mode
URL:
Image URL: https://x.ai/images/news/grok-4-7-og.webp
Summary: A screenshot shared by Lumina (@LuminaBench) shows Grok's Expert mode labeled “Grok 4.7.” It suggests the model is appearing in consumer chat, although the screenshot does not establish which plans or platforms have access or whether the rollout is general.

Title: OpenAI Reduces GPT-6 Pro Chat Limits on Pro 200
URL: https://www.engadget.com/2272106/openai-adds-dollar500-pro-subscription-nerfs-its-existing-dollar200-tier/
Image URL: https://www.engadget.com/img/gallery/openai-adds-500-pro-subscription-nerfs-its-existing-200-tier/l-intro-1790697735.jpg
Summary: OpenAI is cutting GPT-6 Pro’s Chat allowance on its $200/month Pro plan from 200 to 100 messages weekly. Eligible existing subscribers keep their current limits through October 29, 2026; the reduction starts October 30. New subscribers without grandfathering receive the lower allowance immediately. The subscription price stays unchanged.
